program_name: BSc (Hons) Information Systems with Data Analytics

requirements.general_text: Any of These: A-Level/STPM: BCC UEC: 16 points or less (5 subjects not less than B grade) ATAR (WACE/SACE): ATAR 70 Canada Year 12 High School Diploma: 70% (average score of 6 best relevant Grade 12 subjects including English) Matriculation/Foundation: CGPA 3.0 (further assessment is required) Diploma: CGPA 3.0 (further assessment is required) Heriot-Watt University Malaysia Foundation in Business / Foundation in Science: C SMA 3 (Indonesia): 70% Year 12 State Board High School Examination (India): 70% Senior High School Graduation Certificate (China): 80% Additional Academic Requirements: Mathematics: Grade C in Mathematics at SPM/IGCSE or equivalent is required. This requirement can be waived if applicants have obtained at least a passing grade in Mathematics at a higher level. Important Notes: Applications from individuals with a wide range of qualifications are encouraged. Eligibility is best determined by submitting a complete application with academic documents. Entry requirements are subject to change, and individual offers may vary. English Language Requirements: For Non-Native English Speakers: Evidence of English language ability is required. Minimum IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent) with no score lower than 5.5. English Language Courses: Offered for those who do not meet the IELTS 6.0 requirement.
